name: Oathstone Exile

abilities.name: Rubble Stride
abilities.description: Difficult terrain composed of rubble, loose stone, and broken ground doesn't cost the exile extra movement, and the exile can move across rubble, loose stone, and broken ground without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The exile makes two attacks: one with its Stone Club and one with its Boulder.

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (7d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the exile must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from the exile and be knocked prone.
